items.title: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia: Long or short accountability?
items.summary:
Market Hang tackles the top stories of the day. Including Nvidia's board unanimously reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO and what the White House's involvement says about accountability in corporate America, whether the government has effectively put a floor under the AI trade, and Anthropic falling as options on the stock begin trading for the first time.

The panel, with Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman, debates where everyone sits on a one-to-five bullishness scale, whether this is a stock picker's market or a CapEx bubble that precedes a secular bear, the risk of a politically driven slowdown in data center construction, and OpenAI's chief scientist calling for a speed limit on AI development, including whether an FDA-style regulator is the right model for AI.

items.title: Wonder is reportedly exploring a sale of Grubhub
items.summary: The food hall-delivery concept is targeting Walmart, Target, and Kroger as potential buyers of the food delivery service, according to the Wall Street Journal.

items.title: Costco vs. Walmart: One Retail Giant Looks Better for Retirement Investors
items.summary: Both warehouse-club king and discount titan just beat earnings, and both sit near 52-week highs. But one stock already costs more than Wall Street thinks it's worth, and that changes what a retiree should buy before the next paycheck cycle.

items.title: Vuzix stock jumps on reseller deal with Friends With Holograms
items.summary: Investing.com -- Vuzix Corp (NASDAQ:VUZI) shares rose over 8% in trading Monday following the announcement of a reseller agreement with Friends With Holograms, a New York-based company specializing in smart glasses and spatial computing solutions for enterprises.
